title: SQL database
description: SQL database server. The engine tells consuming charts how to address it. Both sides of a claim: properties, what a provider publishes (the connection, with the size and the extensions it granted a claim); x-okdp-secret, what its credentials Secret holds; x-okdp-claim, what a claim may request of a provider that provisions databases.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Read by consuming charts to build their JDBC URL.

driver.title: JDBC driver
driver.description: Driver class name read by charts configuring a JDBC datasource. Follows from the engine.

port.title: Port
port.description: 5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL and MariaDB.

username.title: User
username.description: Stored in the credentials Secret, under the username key.

password.title: Password
password.description: Stored in the credentials Secret, under the password key.

sslMode.title: TLS mode
sslMode.description: 'prefer' tries TLS and falls back to clear text if the server refuses, the safe default for a server you do not control. Use 'verify-full' when the server presents a certificate your cluster trusts.

tls.title: TLS mode
tls.description: MySQL accepts a different set of values from PostgreSQL. 'preferred' tries TLS and falls back to clear text.

size.title: Size
size.description: The size a provider granted the database of a claim, as requested or more. Unset when it grants none of its own: its databases share a server's storage.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: The PostgreSQL extensions a provider installed in the database of a claim, as requested.

x-okdp-claim.title: Database claim
x-okdp-claim.description: What a claim may request of a provider that provisions databases (provisions: database-server): a database of its own, its owner's credentials in a Secret, the extensions installed in it and, when the provider grants one, its size. Defaults apply when a claim asks nothing.

size.title: Size
size.description: The size the database needs. A provider whose databases share a server's storage grants no size of its own, and publishes none: a consumer that needs one requires it of the connection (require).

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: PostgreSQL extensions to install in the database, by their CREATE EXTENSION name (vector is pgvector): the ones of PostgreSQL's contrib and pgvector that need no preloaded library.
